# Accessibility Checklist: The blog ("Drift & Convergence")

**Purpose**: Validate that the accessibility requirements for every blog page and component are complete, clear, consistent and measurable against WCAG 2.2 AA (Constitution Principle X). This tests the requirements as written, not the implementation.
**Created**: 2026-09-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items ask whether requirements are well written; none is evaluated yet.

## Page-Level Requirements

- [x] CHK001 Is the WCAG 2.2 AA requirement stated for each blog template individually (landing, all posts, topic, post, empty states, paginated pages), not only as a blanket claim? [Completeness, Spec §FR-039, SC-005]
- [x] CHK002 Are the conditions for "meets WCAG 2.2 AA" defined (both themes, phone and desktop widths, scripts off, menu open) consistently in the spec, plan and success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §FR-039, SC-005, Plan §Constitution Check X]
- [x] CHK003 Is the heading structure (one h1 per page, order of h2/h3 across lead story, Featured, Latest, related, share) specified for each template? [Gap]
- [x] CHK004 Are landmark and page-title requirements defined for every blog page, including paginated pages (for example "page 2" in the title)? [Gap]
- [x] CHK005 Is the "current section" marker for "Writing" specified as an accessible state (not colour alone) on every blog page? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK006 Is a focus-order requirement defined for pages whose first content is a hero image with an overlapping title card? [Gap, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK007 Is the "never scrolls sideways at 320 px" requirement tied to a measurable check that covers reflow (WCAG 1.4.10) for all templates, not only the post page? [Measurability, Spec §FR-039, SC-006]

## Cards, Pills and Colour

- [x] CHK008 Is the accessible name for a card specified (title link only, or whole card), and is duplicate-link avoidance between image, title and pills defined? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK009 Are text-contrast requirements quantified (4.5:1 body, 3:1 large text and UI components) for every pill, banner, "Featured" mark and topic-coloured border in both themes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK010 Is it stated that the topic-colour border on text-only cards is not the only carrier of meaning? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK011 Are focus-visible and hover state requirements defined consistently for cards, pills, pagination links and the feed link? [Consistency, Gap]
- [x] CHK012 Are target-size requirements (WCAG 2.5.8, 24 px minimum) stated for pills, pagination links, the share button and the copy button? [Gap]
- [x] CHK013 Is the "Featured" mark's non-visual presentation (text, not an icon alone) specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK014 Are the date and reading-time formats specified so they are announced clearly (machine-readable date, "minute read" wording)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, FR-021]
- [x] CHK015 Is the topic pill row given an accessible grouping and label, and is its difference from the "All posts" link defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]

## Pagination

- [x] CHK016 Is the pagination landmark (labelled navigation) and the wording of previous, next and numbered links specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK017 Is "current page identified to assistive technology" defined precisely enough to test (for example a current-page state on the link)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, US4-2]
- [x] CHK018 Are requirements defined for absent or disabled previous/next controls on the first and last page? [Coverage, Edge Case]
- [x] CHK019 Is the numbered-link behaviour specified for long page ranges (truncation, and the address of page 1 as `/writing/all/`)? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]

## Images and Captions

- [x] CHK020 Are text-alternative requirements defined for feature images, body images and decorative images, including when an empty description is permitted? [Consistency, Spec §FR-033, Contracts §build-errors P8, P12]
- [x] CHK021 Is the conflict between "body image with empty alt text fails the build" and any decorative-image need resolved? [Conflict, Spec §FR-033]
- [x] CHK022 Is the semantic relationship between an image and its caption required, for normal, wide and full-width images? [Completeness, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK023 Is the feature image's role on the post page (informative versus decorative) and its description source stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019, FR-030]
- [x] CHK024 Are requirements defined for image loading failure and for images at 400% zoom or in high-contrast mode? [Gap, Edge Case]

## Code Blocks and Copy Button

- [x] CHK025 Are syntax-highlight colours required to meet a stated contrast ratio against the code box background in both themes? [Measurability, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK026 Is keyboard access to a sideways-scrolling code box specified (focusable, labelled region), so long lines are reachable without a mouse? [Gap, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK027 Is the copy button's accessible name specified, including which code sample it refers to when a post has several? [Gap, Spec §FR-025]
- [x] CHK028 Are the success and failure announcements defined (live region, exact wording, duration, return to the original label)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025, US1-4]
- [x] CHK029 Is the focus behaviour after activating the copy button defined (focus stays on the button)? [Gap]
- [x] CHK030 Is the code caption's association with its code box specified for assistive technology? [Gap, Spec §FR-024]

## Tables

- [x] CHK031 Is the scrolling table region specified as keyboard-focusable with an accessible name, and is preserving table semantics testable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-026]
- [x] CHK032 Are header-cell and caption requirements for tables in post bodies specified, including whether the author must supply them? [Gap, Spec §FR-026]

## Share, Draft Notice, Feed Link, Related Posts

- [x] CHK033 Is the share area's semantic structure specified (heading or label, button versus link roles) for both the system share feature and plain links? [Gap, Spec §FR-028]
- [x] CHK034 Are the accessible names of the plain share links specified so each says where it goes (external site or email)? [Gap, Spec §FR-028]
- [x] CHK035 Is the swap between the share button and plain links defined so it causes no layout shift or duplicate announcements? [Gap, Spec §FR-028, US5-2]
- [x] CHK036 Is the visible "Draft" notice required to carry text (not colour alone) and to sit in reading order before the title? [Clarity, Spec §FR-032]
- [x] CHK037 Are the "Subscribe (RSS)" link's visible text and accessible name specified, separately from feed autodiscovery on every page? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, FR-037]
- [x] CHK038 Are the related-posts section's heading and list semantics specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-029]
- [x] CHK039 Is the "views are my own" note's semantic role specified (plain text, not an alert or hidden element)? [Gap, Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK040 Are empty-state messages required to keep the page's heading and landmarks intact? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014]

## Motion, Themes and Scripts Off

- [x] CHK041 Are reduced-motion requirements defined for any hover, transition or scroll effect on cards and the hero overlap? [Gap]
- [x] CHK042 Is the contrast requirement for the code theme, pills and banners stated for light and dark themes separately, with how each is measured? [Measurability, Spec §FR-017, FR-024]
- [x] CHK043 Are the scripts-off requirements for interactive parts (copy button hidden, share links shown) consistent across the stories and FR-025/FR-028? [Consistency, Spec §US1-5, US5-2]
- [x] CHK044 Is text-spacing and 200% zoom resilience stated for the title card overlapping the feature image (no clipped text)? [Gap, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK045 Is a very long title or unbroken word required to stay readable and reflow without loss, and is the measure stated? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
